assigned.authorization_source: President instruction 2026-11-04: assign 90-day activities and remaining backlog to paired roles, start preparation and show manual/approval needs.

president_actions.title: Review Jodibana operator demo and business settings
president_actions.instructions: Name the reviewer and complete the operator/community demo plus business/tax/privacy and tenant opt-in acceptance review. Preserve free JodiUSA access. Live collection remains disabled until the existing launch gates pass.

president_actions.title: Provide owned publishing accounts and the email footer address
president_actions.instructions: Specify the exact social pages/accounts the business controls and the business mailing address for campaign footers. CMO must verify product-specific consent; imported or researched contacts are not permissioned recipients.

president_actions.title: Confirm backup custody and monitored recovery alerts
president_actions.instructions: Confirm the external-drive custodian, separate recovery-key escrow and monitored alert recipient. The drive repair and restore test already passed; recurring coverage and historical deletion continuity still need evidence.

president_actions.title: Activate the ten human role logins
president_actions.instructions: Name the people covering CEO, CFO, CMO, CTO and COO for each company. Set temporary passwords privately through Accounts & integrations and have each person change the password. No password is requested in task evidence.

president_actions.title: Supply remaining accounting evidence for CFO review
president_actions.instructions: Provide locations of revenue/deferred-revenue records, supplier bills, partner payouts and owner/support time not already in the expense evidence. Existing approved allocations remain provisional; do not repeat the earlier allocation approval.

president_actions.title: Confirm the home of the ten additional portfolio products
president_actions.instructions: Confirm the company, responsible unit and intended private/public scope for Charam, Atmasphere LLM, SDIS, One-Man Hedge Fund, Quantsys, SMDP Design, Stablecoin Pipeline, Vanguard GTM, Vireoka Website and Atmakosh Website. Internal products remain private; unclear products remain discovery.

president_actions.title: Identify TCompprop operational source records
president_actions.instructions: Provide the system or file locations for properties, leases, maintenance and associated income/cost evidence. The existing TCompprop cases cannot validate unavailable sources.

president_actions.title: Arrange Postmark account-level retention capability
president_actions.instructions: The retained provider-history gate says the account-level Data Removal API and suitable token are not configured. Have the account owner confirm current availability with Postmark. Provide only a protected secret location if configured; server tokens are insufficient.
